Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.nativewindow

Class NativePane

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.sg.SceneGraphObject
org.jdesktop.lg3d.sg.Node
org.jdesktop.lg3d.sg.Group
org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.nativewindow.NativePane
public class NativePane extends Group
This is the root of the actual Native window geometry, it does not contain the 3D window decorations. This class is used in the LowLevelPicker to determine when the mouse is over screen space being rendered by X.
